lines.x: Welcome. This is our village. Small, for now.
Every light you make gives someone a home.
Something came for you. The mailbox looks proud.
That dark window? Someone's coming tomorrow.
Someone new moved in. Say hi whenever you like.
Pick one you like. The others will come around again.
This is your room. Put things wherever feels right.
The season turned while we weren't looking. {cp}.
Good pick. It'll look nice somewhere.
The stall opens once a lantern is lit today. No rush.
Nice room. It looks properly lived-in now.
I'm Wick. I keep the lamps. And an eye on things.
The cabin by the gate is yours. I'm right next door.
Early. The lanterns are still yawning.
Good day. The village is quiet and doing fine.
Dusk. My favorite hour. Everything's a bit gold.
Late night? Me too. The lights don't mind.
Ah, it's you. The path got brighter just now.
Nicely lit. I watched from the stepping stone.
Clean and calm. That's the way. {cp}.
There you are. Everything kept glowing.
Welcome back. Your bench is still warm. Somehow.
Spring. Sage keeps waking up in new pots.
Long evenings. More dusk for everyone.
Leaves on the path. I like how they crunch.
Winter. Lanterns look their best in the cold.
Your cabin corner is dark. Any lamp would do.
A little table, maybe? Somewhere to set the tea.
That lamp idea still stands. Whenever. {cp}.
There. Nobody sits in the dark now.

Hello,
This lamp was the first one I ever lit.
It's yours now. Welcome home. — Wick

Hello,
The lantern jar is full again. Your doing.
Here's something for the room. — Wick

Hello,
The corner's lit now. People stop there to talk.
Thank you. — Wick

Hello,
The village kept your place warm.
Nothing's missing. Come by anytime. — Wick
One more, for the room.
You know, the village talks about you. All good things.
I'm glad it was you who came. Truly.
Still here. I usually am. {cp}.
Oh—hi. I'm Momo. I practiced saying hello. {cp}.
You lit this house? For… me? Oh. Thank you.
Morning… I meant to fix my petal first.
Hi! Oh, that was loud. Hi.
The sky's pink now. It's showing off. I like it.
You're up late too? Let's be quiet together.
Hi! I didn't even hide this time. Progress!
You did it! Um. I clapped. You didn't see.
That was lovely. Like petals opening, one by one.
Oh! Hi! I saved you the good cushion.
You're here. I was hoping. Um. Hi.
Blossom season. I blend right in. So relaxing.
It's warm. My cheeks are pink for real reasons now.
The leaves are turning red. I know the feeling.
Cold noses, pink cheeks. Everyone matches me!
Um… a cushion, maybe? For sitting bravely.
Could there be flowers somewhere? Only if it's easy.
The cushion thing… no rush. Really. {cp}.
I'm sitting in your room! Is this okay? It's okay.

Um, hello,
I hugged this cushion whenever I got scared.
Now it's yours. — Momo

Um, hello,
I saw this and thought of your room.
I hope that's not strange. {cp}. — Momo

Um, hello,
I sat in your room. I wasn't scared at all.
Thank you. Truly. — Momo
Me again. Sorry! {cp}.
Can I tell you something? I like when you visit.
I made you something. Open it after I leave. {cp}!
{cp}! Oh—it's you. Hi again.
Mm… hello. I was napping in your flowerpot. Sorry.
I'm Sage. I grow things. Slowly. Like me.
Dawn watering. The plants drink. I… mm… yawn.
Sunny. Good for leaves. Good for naps. Mostly naps.
Dusk. The flowers are closing. I'll follow their lead.
{cp}… still up? Even the moss is asleep.
Oh, you. I'd wake up for you. I just did, in fact.
Nicely done. Like each seed in its own spot.
Mm. I'd have napped halfway. You didn't.
Back already? I only just woke up.
A new leaf came out while you were away. Look.
Spring. Everything wants to grow. Even me, a bit.
Too sunny. I'm napping in the shade of a fern.
Seeds everywhere. Next year is already planning.
The garden is resting. So am I. It's only fair.
A little plant for your windowsill? The light's good.
Something soft underfoot? For… napping. Obviously.
Still thinking about that plant. Plants are patient.
Your plant and I are getting along. Mm. Nap time.

Mm, hello,
An empty pot. What grows in it is up to you.
{cp}. — Sage

Mm, hello,
Found this while weeding. Well, while napping.
For your room. — Sage

Mm, hello,
I napped in your room. Best nap this season.
Thank you. {cp}. — Sage
Mm. Another one. {cp}.
You come back like spring does. Quietly. Good.
I planted something for you. It'll take a while. Worth it.
Mm? Oh. I was resting my eyes. Both of them.
Hello! Is it night yet? I'm Luna. I watch the sky.
Your village has very good sky. I checked.
Morning already? I was counting stars. Lost count.
Daytime. The stars are still up there. Just shy.
Dusk! The first star is always the bravest.
{cp}! Look up. No, more up. There.
A night owl too? Let's name a star.
Every lantern in place. Like a constellation!
Did you know lanterns are stars that decided to stay?
The stars moved a little. You're right on time.
You're back! I saved you the best patch of sky.
Spring nights are soft. The stars look well rested.
Short nights. I have to stargaze very fast.
The moon's so round tonight. We're related, I think.
Cold air makes the stars sharper. Worth the shivers.
Something for your wall? A clock, so I know it's late.
A little light by your window? For the night shift.
Still dreaming of that wall thing. Dreams can wait.
From your window I can see three new stars. Hi, stars.

To you, under the same sky,
This is for counting the hours till night.
{cp}. — Luna

To you, under the same sky,
This fell out of the night. I think it's yours.
— Luna

To you, under the same sky,
Your room is the best observatory in town.
Thank you! {cp}. — Luna
Another little star. {cp}.
I named a star after you. The small one. It tries hard.
If you ever feel lost, find the moon. I'll be under it.
Hm? Sorry, I was up on a cloud. Hello!
Hi hi! I'm Pip! I'm small but I cheer big! {cp}!
Is this my house? It's huge! Or I'm tiny. Both!
Morning! I'm up! I've been up for ages! {cp}!
Hi! I cheered for a cloud. It moved. Success!
Sunset! Good job today, sun! You did great!
{cp}… I'm cheering very quietly. Yay. Yay.
Guess what! Nothing! But I'm happy anyway!
You did it! {cp}! {cp}! I knew it!
Yay! Can I tell everyone? I'm telling everyone.
You're here! {cp}! Okay. Hi. {cp}!
I made up a brand-new cheer while you were out!
Flowers! I cheered and they opened. Probably me.
Summer! Big sun! I'm a tiny sun! {cp}!
Leaf pile! I jumped in. Someone please find me.
Snow is cold! I'm warm! We'll work it out!
A rug for your room? Something to hop on? Please?
Something little, like me? For a shelf?
Rug! Rug! …That's the whole cheer. No rush!
Your rug is perfect for hopping. {cp}! {cp}!

HI!
This rug is for hopping. I tested it. A lot.
Yay! — Pip

HI!
I found a thing! It's for you! That's the letter!
{cp}! — Pip

HI!
I hopped on your rug 100 times. Maybe 101.
You're the best! — Pip
Another one! {cp}!
You're my favorite to cheer for. Don't tell!
I made a cheer just for you. It's very loud. Ready?
{cp}! Oh, hi! {cp}!
Hello, hello. I'm Kuri. I brought tea. And yarn.
A fireplace! Oh, I'll be very happy here.
Early bird? Kettle's on. {cp}
Afternoon. I'm on row forty. Or fourteen. Hm.
Dusk. Time to light the fire and get comfy.
Can't sleep? Sit by the fire. I'll keep knitting.
I made too much soup again. Help me out?
Well done. That deserves a biscuit. Here.
Neat as a good stitch. Every one in its place.
Tea's still warm. Funny how that works.
There you are. I kept your seat by the fire.
Spring cleaning! I found three scarves I forgot.
Too warm for scarves. I'm knitting one anyway.
Chestnut season. My favorite. Can you tell?
Cold out. Come in. I knitted the door a cozy.
A spot for my yarn in your room? A basket, a pot…
A chair by your window? I knit better sitting down.
About that yarn spot. No rush at all. Truly.
Lovely spot. I'll just knit a row or two here.

For you, with tea,
A basket for odds and ends. Everyone needs one.
{cp} — Kuri

For you, with tea,
I meant to knit a scarf. This happened instead.
Enjoy! — Kuri

For you, with tea,
Your room is my favorite place to knit now.
Come warm up anytime. — Kuri
And one more. {cp}
I've started something in your size. {cp}
I finished it. It's a scarf. Mostly. Try it on?
{cp} Oh! Dropped a stitch. Never mind. Hello!
…Hi. I'm Yuki. It's quiet here. Good.
Does it snow here? …I'll wait.
Dawn is the quietest. {cp}. Listen.
Hi. …That's all. It's a nice hi, though.
The light goes blue after sunset. My color.
Night. Cold air. Stars. Enough.
Oh. You. …I don't mind talking to you.
Nice. Quiet and neat. Like fresh snow.
Oh. Pretty.
…Oh. Hi. I'm glad.
I didn't count the days. I just looked up. You.
The snow's gone. I kept some in my memory. {cp}.
Too bright. I'll sit in the shade and think cold.
The air is getting sharper. Soon, maybe.
Snow on every roof. The village looks asleep.
It's snowing. …{cp}. Don't say anything. Just look.
A small bed in your room? I nap where it's quiet.
A shelf? For quiet things. Books, mostly.
The bed. …Whenever. I can wait.
It's quiet in here. …Thank you.

Hi.
This is for your window. It stays cold-looking.
{cp}. — Yuki

Hi.
Found this in the snow. It wasn't cold.
For you. — Yuki

Hi.
I slept in your room. No noise at all.
Thank you. {cp}. — Yuki
One more. {cp}.
I saved a snowflake for you. …It melted. Sorry.
When it snows next, sit with me. No talking needed.
{cp}… oh. It's you. Okay.
